newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 85.9 bln marks of repos, adds funds.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 85.9 bln marks of repos, adds funds.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it had allocated 85.9 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at a fixed three percent rate.

The central bank accepted 30.10 percent of the bids for the 14-day funds. A repo pact for 82.4 billion marks, also set at a fixed three percent rate, expires today, Wednesday, so a net 3.5 billion marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank has kept its main money market rate, the repo, fixed at three percent since last August.
Banks bid for a total of 285.2 billion marks of the funds.
